warnings: *** THE ROOM LABEL ON THIS SECTION IS WRONG ON THE DRAWING, AND IT IS RECORDED AS PRINTED RATHER THAN CORRECTED. *** It reads ห้องนอน 3 +0.60. Verified at 9x magnification, both the name and the level, so it is not a misreading. But ห้องนอน 3 is an UPSTAIRS bedroom at +4.00 on A-05, on A-08's รูปตัด ก, and by its own พ6 timber floor finish; +0.60 is the ground-floor living level. The two cannot both describe one space. The section itself shows the front porch column and the entrance steps, so the room behind it at +0.60 is a ground-floor room - รับแขก on A-04, which is exactly what รูปตัดขยาย 3 on this same sheet labels its equivalent space. This is a labelling error on A-16, most likely a copy from another sheet. The element keeps the printed text in printed_as, takes a descriptive element_id that does not claim to be ห้องนอน 3, and carries a low confidence with an explicit flag. Nothing was silently renamed and no correct-looking name was invented.
This is the second labelling error found on the architectural set, after A-08's ซักล้าง +0.50 against the plans' +0.40. Both are single-sheet slips against multiple agreeing sheets.
The 1.60 m bottom dimension is the ข-to-ก grid distance, same as รูปตัดขยาย 1, and the column profile (ø0.32 / ø0.28) is identical - the two sections cut the same porch at different points.
